import json
def boxes(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or not(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W) or g[y][x]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); cells.append((y,x))
                    stack += [(y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)]
                ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                out.append((min(xs),min(ys),max(xs),max(ys),col))
    out.sort(key=lambda b:b[0])
    return out
def transform(g):
    bs=boxes(g)
    h=max(b[3]-b[1]+1 for b in bs)
    wtot=sum(b[2]-b[0]+1 for b in bs)
    o=[[0]*wtot for _ in range(h)]
    c=0
    for x0,y0,x1,y1,col in bs:
        for y in range(y0,y1+1):
            for x in range(x0,x1+1):
                if g[y][x]: o[y-y0][c+x-x0]=g[y][x]
        c+=x1-x0+1
    return o
# check demo
di,do=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
r=transform(di)
print(r==do, r)
t=transform(G['Test input'])
for r in t: print(r)
print(json.dumps(t))
